title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5, its first generally available Mythos-class model, claiming state-of-the-art results on nearly all benchmarks (e.g. 80.3% SWE-Bench Pro vs 58.6% for GPT-5.5); Mythos 5, the same model with cyber safeguards lifted, went to Project Glasswing partners only.
reason: New frontier model with large self-reported gains; T3 not assigned because benchmarks are self-reported (skeptic pass).

title: Taiwan weighs curbing AI chip exports to all Chinese customers
summary: Bloomberg reported Taiwan is considering extending AI chip export curbs to all of China to align with US controls.

title: EU and Apple clash over Siri AI not launching in Europe
summary: Apple said Siri AI won't launch in the EU due to the Digital Markets Act; the Commission said the decision was Apple's and refused an 18-month exemption.
reason: EU holds DMA line against big-tech AI rollout.
